## Material-change review (conditional)

Complete this section only when the change materially affects behavior, public contracts, schema/state, security, payments, concurrency, reliability, architecture, or a significant workflow. Otherwise remove it or state `N/A — <reason>`.

For material work, score 0–2 with evidence. Convergence requires at least 8/10 and no zero in specification, correctness, or security.
